item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-12
item.description: The Global Times publishes the first official articulation of China's 'iterative logic' of open-source AI as institutional doctrine; Zuckerberg releases 'The Future is for Everyone' manifesto and Meta's Muse model family as a direct institutional counter-move to China's open-weight dominance; Chinese AI labs drive global enterprise API costs to a 2026 low, creating a new institutional pricing regime; the US House Homeland Security Committee deepens its investigation into Chinese AI models in US critical infrastructure.

item.title: 2026-08-12 「开源之道」·荐书：黑客伦理与信息时代精神 — Pekka Himanen
item.description: 海曼用一本小书，回答了开源世界里一个从未被真正追问的问题：为什么优秀的人愿意免费劳动？

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-11
item.description: DeepSeek releases V4-Flash under MIT license — the first Chinese frontier open-weight model under a truly permissive OSI-style license; Alibaba moves Qwen toward revenue-sharing for large commercial users, creating a new 'open weights, paid use' institutional form; Reuters and Yahoo report Beijing has met with Alibaba and ByteDance to discuss curbing overseas access to its most advanced AI models, moving the July export-control debate from rumor toward implementation.

item.title: 2026-08-11 「开源之道」·荐书：Reinventing Discovery — Michael Nielsen
item.description: 当互联网让大规模协作成为可能，科学发现被重写——Nielsen 用 EMBL、Wikipathways、Foldit 等案例证明：网络化科学需要的是制度，而不只是网络。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-10
item.description: China accelerates the OSSification of industrial infrastructure: the OpenAtom Foundation launches its Control Systems Open Source Community on the industrial-software conference stage; Anolis (OpenAnolis) donates itself to OpenAtom and rebrands as 'AI-native'; The Diplomat charts WAICO's institutional agenda in the West's absence; KAIYUANSHE publishes its 2026 board of directors.

item.title: 2026-08-10 「开源之道」·荐书：OSS商业应用教科书「守り」と「攻め」— 中村雄一 等
item.description: 日立与索尼的 OSPO 操盘手联袂，把 OSPO 从合规部门重塑为战略资产管理中心——防守 + 进攻 + 四阶段成熟度。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-09
item.description: DeepSeek resumes its $8B funding round at a $74B valuation as Monolith — the same Chinese backer behind Moonshot AI — enters negotiations; TechNode reports DeepSeek plans significant API price increases; OpenAtom Foundation publishes the AIP Agent Interconnection Protocol on its domestic AtomGit platform, operationalizing China's first national standard for AI agent interconnection; Monolith announces a $500M new fund.

item.title: 2026-08-09 「开源之道」·荐书：The Economics of Technology Sharing — Lerner & Tirole
item.description: 用 22 页把开源、商业、产权、信号与许可证选择全部装进同一套分析框架——开源经济学最完整的一次综述。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-08
item.description: DeepSeek pivots to industrial strategy with a $20.8M investment in Unitree's Shanghai IPO; Tiangong Kaiwu and CAICT co-found a Chinese counter to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation; CAICT launches OpenClaw-class open-source agent innovation practice while flagging security risks; KAIYUANSHE announces its 2026 board of directors.

item.title: 2026-08-08 「开源之道」·荐书：General Theory of Economic Evolution — Dopfer & Potts
item.description: 以规则（rules）为分析基本单位的演化经济学通论——开源社区的协作，正是规则变异、采纳与传播的经济演化样本。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-07
item.description: US-China schedule first official AI talks under Trump; Bessent warns of sanctions over AI IP 'theft'; China formalizes WAICO with 29 founding members; SPC overhauls chip-design IP with punitive damages; controversial open-source licensing rulings continue to shape China's legal landscape.

item.title: 2026-08-07 「开源之道」·荐书：The Economics of Knowledge — Dominique Foray
item.description: Foray 用经济学证明：知识是特殊的资本品，需要专门制度来组织——这正是开源许可证与共同体存在的理论根基。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-06
item.description: DeepSeek's $71B valuation and state-controlled governance structure expose a 'Chinese Dual Ownership' model; Moonshot AI closes $3.5B round at $35B as IPO wave institutionalizes AI wealth; Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max launches with aggressive open-weight pricing.

item.title: 2026-08-06 「开源之道」·荐书：A Culture of Growth — Joel Mokyr
item.description: 莫基尔以诺奖之笔论证：增长的根本动力是观念与文化，而非资本与资源——开源，正是这种增长文化的数字回响。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-05
item.description: Qiushi Issue 15 frames open-weight AI as a boon for the world; The Economist analyzes China's superior AI efficiency; Foreign Policy says US is betting the house on AI race; TechCrunch/AISI reports open-weight models catching frontier; Washington Post says Washington mobilizing against Chinese AI threat.

item.title: 2026-08-05 「开源之道」·荐书：The Economic Institutions of Capitalism — Oliver E. Williamson
item.description: 治理结构的选择取决于交易的性质——威廉姆森的 L1-L4 治理层级框架，是解剖开源社区为何不能套用科层制的最锋利的手术刀。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-04
item.description: Hugging Face CEO declares China is winning the AI race due to open model culture; Chinese media amplifies the narrative; Hugging Face Spring 2026 report confirms China surpassed US in open-source AI downloads.

item.title: 2026-08-04 「开源之道」·荐书：Economic Behavior and Institutions — Thrainn Eggertsson
item.description: 制度不是外在于人的规则，而是在经济行为中不断被学习、重复与重塑的过程——这一演化视角，是理解开源制度如何自发生长的理论基石。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-03
item.description: Taiwan's hardware giants launch TAIONE foundation to claim open-source AI governance; Chinese AI IPO rush accelerates with DeepSeek and Moonshot; US lead over China in AI disappears; the social costs of AI deployment in China come into focus; DeepSeek pauses $71B funding round after founder's viral comments; China creates world's first AI agent regulatory framework.

item.title: 2026-08-03 「开源之道」·荐书：Dreaming in Code — Scott Rosenberg
item.description: Chandler 的失败告诉我们：开源的成功有其偶然，而开源的失败却有共同的规律。这是极少数认真研究「开源为什么会失败」的书。

item.title: 2026-08-02 「开源之道」·荐书：Coding Freedom — E. Gabriella Coleman
item.description: 当经济学家用激励解释开源时，Coleman 走进黑客的田野——黑客不仅是程序员，更是将自由、透明与审美合一的道德共同体。

item.title: 2026-08-01 「开源之道」·荐书：The Institutionalization of Open Source — Robert A. Gehring
item.description: Gehring 是第一个用新制度经济学框架系统分析开源的人：吸引 IBM 等巨头拥抱开源的，不是软件免费，而是它的制度框架。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-31
item.description: State media consolidates open-weight AI success narrative; openEuler Hong Kong User Group launches with 22 members; West debates slowing AI as China builds parallel governance; the open-weight dilemma emerges.

item.title: 2026-07-31 「开源之道」·荐书：Bowling Alone — Robert D. Putnam
item.description: Robert Putnam 告诉我们：开源社区的真正瓶颈，可能不在技术，而在社会资本——信任、互惠与共同参与的根基。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-30
item.description: Datang Group deploys Dianhong IoT OS multi-modal AI for wind farm intelligent monitoring; SOE open-source ecosystem expands beyond CR Power.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-29
item.description: Kimi K3 open-source model challenges closed-source AI dominance; OpenAtom 'Park Tour' Hong Kong Station launches openEuler's first overseas regional community.

item.title: 2026-07-29 「开源之道」·荐书：Free Culture — Lawrence Lessig
item.description: Lawrence Lessig 追问：知识产权本为激励创造而生，为何却成了锁住文化的枷锁？开源与 Creative Commons，正是把'自由'还给创作者的制度设计。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-28
item.description: CCF ChinaOSC 2026 preview: Xenomai real-time OS for embodied intelligence; OpenAtom Deep Report finds AI open source entering 'ecosystem decisive' era; CR Power's RunDianHong IoT OS for power systems.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-27
item.description: 70+ local open source policies mark China's shift to 'value realization' phase; Zhejiang's 7-department open source system plan; Embodied AI's open source moment with 3M+ OpenLET dataset downloads; OpenAtom prepares AI Agent working group.

item.title: [Data] 「开源之道」·荐书：规则的乌托邦 — 大卫·格雷伯
item.description: 从人类学视角审视官僚制的起源与暴力，为开源治理提供一面自我批判的镜子。

item.title: 《Why We Don't Admit Wrong》— Tversky & Aronson
item.description: 承认错误是人类最难的行为之一，而开源正是少数能让'代码说话'、把技术对错与人的面子分开的制度安排

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-24
item.description: MIIT quantifies China's open source ecosystem for the first time: 1.35B OpenHarmony devices, 10B model downloads; Jensen Huang defends Chinese open-source AI; White House specifically accuses Moonshot AI of distilling Fable 5; Arcee says Chinese models not inherently dangerous.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-23
item.description: China launches WAICO, a 29-nation AI governance bloc backing open-source AI; Mulan License Family donated to OpenAtom Foundation; China's anthropomorphic AI rules take effect; Beijing weighs export controls on its own AI models.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-22
item.description: US Treasury threatens sanctions on Chinese open-source AI models over IP theft; MIT Technology Review analyzes how Chinese AI divides Trump's camp; China explicitly champions open source at UN's first global AI governance dialogue.

item.title: 2026年7月22日，「开源之书」今日推荐：《From a Firm-Based to a Community-Based Model of Knowledge Creation》
item.description: Lee & Cole (2003) 以 Linux 内核开发为案例，提出了从企业模式到社区模式的知识创造理论框架。本文将同行评审概念化为「知识过滤器」，揭示了开源社区作为知识进化系统的制度逻辑——这是理解「为什么开源能产生高质量知识」的必读经典。

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-21
item.description: NDRC eight-point AI Action Plan, Trump admin considers ban on Chinese open-source models, Mulan copyleft license submitted to OSI, and Qiushi essay on AI ideology

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-20
item.description: WAICO founded, Kimi K3 released as largest open-source model, Xi calls for open collaboration at WAIC 2026, and openKylin advances AI-native OS

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-19
item.description: Xi Jinping champions open-source AI at WAIC 2026; Moonshot's Kimi K3 becomes the largest open-weight model ever; China releases AI cooperation action plan; Beijing studies export controls on frontier models.

item.title: 每日推荐：《Two Bits: The Cultural Significance of Free Software》— Christopher M. Kelty
item.description: UCLA人类学家Kelty提出了开源研究中最重要的概念之一——「递归公共性」（Recursive Publics）。这不是一本关于如何写代码的书，而是一本关于Geeks如何通过写代码来写社会契约的书。

item.title: 每日推荐：《Coding Freedom: The Ethics and Aesthetics of Hacking》— E. Gabriella Coleman
item.description: 每日推荐：《Coding Freedom: The Ethics and Aesthetics of Hacking》— E. Gabriella Coleman

item.title: 《大教堂与集市》— Eric S. Raymond
item.description: 《大教堂与集市》是开源运动最具标志性的著作，由五篇核心文章组成。其中最著名的同名长文「大教堂与集市」提出了影响深远的软件开发社会学模型： - **大教堂模式（Cathedral）**：传统封闭式开发，像中世纪建造教堂一样，由少数专家精心规划、严格分工、按蓝图施工。源代码在每次发布前严格保密。 - **集市模式（Bazaar）**：开放式开发，像喧闹的露天集市一样，代码公开、贡献开放、版本频繁。L

item.title: 每日推荐：《The Wealth of Networks》
item.description: 每日推荐：《The Wealth of Networks》

item.title: 《The Success of Open Source》— Steven Weber
item.description: Steven Weber 是一位政治学家，他从政治学与制度经济学的交叉视角提出了一个 provocative 的问题：当标准经济理论预测它不应该成功时，开源为何成功了？ Weber 论证的核心是：开源的成功并非经济学的反常例外。开源社区实际上是由一套精密的**规则、标准、决策程序和制裁机制**所引导的。他将开源视为一种**政治经济制度**——不是一个市场，也不是一家公司，而是一种独特的治理结构，
